response.what_it_is: Sony PlayStation 4 console with camouflage skin, two wireless controllers in boxes, and power/HDMI cables
visible_condition: custom camouflage wrap applied to console
hidden_risks: Console internal condition and potential overheating
Controller stick drift or button wear inside the boxes
Whether games are actually loaded and accessible on the hard drive
Account ban status or network restrictions
response.best_proof: Photo of the console powered on showing the dashboard and game library
seller_claims_unsupported: Original Sony DualShock controllers (boxes clearly show X6 third-party controllers)
response.failure_mode: Assuming the bundled controllers are official Sony DualShock 4s when the packaging shows third-party X6 brand, and taking advertised loaded games for granted.
